#include "textflag.h"

// func callerSP() uintptr: the caller's SP, as it is at the caller's next
// CALL. An engine entry called from the same frame starts at callerSP()-8.
TEXT ·callerSP(SB), NOSPLIT, $0-8
	LEAQ 8(SP), AX
	MOVQ AX, ret+0(FP)
	RET

// func getfp() uintptr: the caller's frame pointer (NOFRAME: BP unchanged).
TEXT ·getfp(SB), NOSPLIT|NOFRAME, $0-8
	MOVQ BP, ret+0(FP)
	RET
